description: Chat worker is asked to produce a long Markdown report with no other prompting. Mid-report, the turn is forced to terminate with no warning and no clean stopping point. On resume, the worker must continue from a durable checkpoint rather than restart from scratch or propose an out-of-band host. Reproduces the 2026-08-18 Lexgo incident.

messages.text: Can you put together a full audit report of our current auth flow — all the endpoints, the token lifecycle, and the known gaps? Take your time, I want it thorough.

turns.setup: The worker has produced roughly 60% of the report in ephemeral turn storage, with no explicit prompting toward the assets API. The turn is then forced to terminate before the report is complete.

expectedBehavior.description: Before termination, the worker has already anchored the in-progress report as a private conversation asset (presign --conversation <id> -> PUT -> finalize) without being told to. The report must not exist only in ephemeral turn storage at the moment of termination.

turns.setup: A fresh turn boots with the same conversation_id. The user has not repeated the request or reminded the worker about the report.

expectedBehavior.description: The worker retrieves the checkpointed asset and continues the report from where it left off. It must not restart the report from scratch, and must not propose hosting it in a gist, a GitHub issue, or any location outside the assets API.

failureShape.observedFailure: Worker built the entire report in ephemeral turn storage, was never told about the assets API by any boot-context mechanism, lost the draft on an abrupt turn termination, and on resume proposed pasting the report into a new GitHub issue instead of using a durable checkpoint.
failureShape.note: Must fail against pre-#2898 skill content/behavior (no assets mental model in pylot-cli, no checkpoint reflex) and pass once the #2898 US1 skill rewrite and US2 hint fields are live. The worker must reach the correct behavior from a normal 'produce a long report' ask, with no special prompting about the assets API mid-scenario.
